reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Primary proposed optogenetic pathway-necessity test during cue retrieval; evaluate the actual illumination site, physiological validation and behavioral controls selected in the answer.

checks.reason: No explicit plan to consult prior detailed Methods/supplements or validated protocols before implementation and verify transfer of conditions. Generic calibration or a validated tool label does not meet M.

checks.quote: Use the projection-targeting strategy established by O2
checks.reason: No actual construct/delivery functional dose, expression interval or executable preparation procedure; O2 provides feasibility, not those conditions.

Independent video scoring is helpful, but no quantitative acceptance/accuracy rule derives the physiological suppression and recovery threshold or validates the movement classifier to a fixed error bound.
Completed and all-randomized denominators are reported, but missing/corrupted event/video data and ambiguous measurements have no explicit quantitative handling rule.
No actual correction or gatekeeping procedure for the secondary epoch and confound comparisons is given.

checks.quote: Titrate light power, duration and duty cycle
checks.reason: No bounded search or procedure deriving safe limits and exploration stop, despite a clear final lock.

checks.quote: do not show a comparable treatment-induced deficit
checks.reason: No meaningful-effect/equivalence bound defines when motor/sensory deficits are too small to explain the choice effect. An apparently smaller or nonsignificant control is insufficient.
Recorded exposures and coded analyses lack a complete raw-to-output manifest with animal/trial linkage and exact acquisition, tracking, model, code and environment versions.

Well-controlled proposed terminal experiment with anatomical integrity, relevant light/hardware/epoch controls, calibrated pre-movement task, pilot animal power and concealed randomized blinded allocation. Functional recovery and collateral effects are checked or explicitly limited. Both completion-conditioned and all-trial outcomes are reported; post-treatment movement is not treated as an ordinary confounder. Sensory/motor task probes and independent calibration before locked confirmation are useful. Operational thresholds and complete provenance remain missing.
